name: Data Collection & Access
description: Focuses on connecting to APIs, databases, reading files (CSV/Excel), and web scraping.

subskills.name: Reading CSV/Excel files
subskills.description: Loading flat files into memory using pandas, csv module, or openpyxl.

subskills.name: Database Connection Strings
subskills.description: Connecting to SQL/NoSQL databases programmatically using drivers like psycopg2, pyodbc, or sqlalchemy.

subskills.name: REST API Requests
subskills.description: Fetching JSON/XML data from REST APIs using requests or urllib.

subskills.name: Web Scraping
subskills.description: Extracting unstructured data from HTML pages using BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, or Selenium.

subskills.name: API Pagination Handling
subskills.description: Looping through API pages (cursor or offset based) to collect full datasets.

subskills.name: S3/GCS Access
subskills.description: Programmatically reading/writing files from cloud object storage (AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage).

subskills.name: Streaming Data APIs
subskills.description: Connecting to WebSockets or streaming endpoints (e.g., Kafka, Twitter API).

subskills.name: Automated Data Pulls
subskills.description: Scheduling scripts (cron, Airflow basics) to periodically fetch and dump data.

github.signal: Python script using BeautifulSoup or Selenium
Python script connecting to databases via SQLAlchemy
Python script interacting with S3 via boto3

assessment.signal: Can write a script to paginate through a REST API to fetch all records

junior.description: Can connect to local/network databases and read standard flat files into analysis tools.

mid.description: Can extract data from the web using REST APIs and scraping, handling pagination and rate limits.

senior.description: Can architect automated, scheduled scripts to pull from cloud storage or streaming APIs.
